name: thought-path
description: Live decision maps, tool activity and reported token usage for Copilot Agent chat.

languageModelTools.name: thoughtpath_recordDecision
languageModelTools.userDescription: Show a concise decision summary in ThoughtPath.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Record a concise development decision in the ThoughtPath graph. Call this tool when active ThoughtPath instructions request reporting or the user asks for it. A prose explanation in chat does not update the graph. Report only approaches actually considered: exactly one chosen approach and optional rejected alternatives, with brief user-facing justifications. Do not provide private chain-of-thought or invent alternatives. State whether the outcome is completed or pending. For multiple decisions, call once per decision in sequence. When a decision builds on a previous recorded outcome in this conversation, set parentReportId to that call’s returned thoughtpathReportId. Omit it for unrelated decisions; never guess a parent ID.

goal.description: Concise summary of the user request.

reason.description: Brief justification suitable for the user.

outcome.description: Result, or clearly mark as pending.

parentReportId.description: Optional thoughtpathReportId returned by an earlier call in this conversation whose outcome this decision builds on. Omit for an independent decision. Call parents before children.

enumDescriptions: Follow the current VS Code theme.
thoughtpath.theme.description: Color theme for the decision graph.

thoughtpath.automaticReporting.description: Provide Copilot decision-reporting instructions while the ThoughtPath panel is open in this window. The recordDecision tool must be enabled.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run clean && npm run compile
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.test:unit: npm run compile && node --test out/test/trace.test.js out/test/live.test.js
